newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: BANGLADESH TAKA RISES ON DOLLAR SUPPLY.
newsitem.headline: BANGLADESH TAKA RISES ON DOLLAR SUPPLY.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka posted major gains against the U.S. dollar on Tuesday as a fresh inflow of remittances boosted dollar supply in the interbank market, dealers said.
The taka finished at 44.1950/1970 per dollar, against a previous close at 44.2100/2110.
The local unit opened at 44.2000/2050 per dollar but gained further ground later amid liberal selling of the dollar by state-owned and foreign banks.
Call money was traded at Monday's rates of between 4.5 and 6.5 percent.
